player_prompt.intro:
Tqadart ad teḥṣeb luḍa n Sokoban. Tkijjit d umurar, ḥma ad teẓreg takat iɣeln.
        Mqqar tgaḍiḍ ɣef wakud n takat, tzemreḍ ad tteẓreg takat s tɣarast nneɣt.
        Ur tzemreḍ ad tteẓreg takat ḍef wakud, ur tzemreḍ ad ttejbed takat.
        Ɣef wakud, isafen ganin: 
        - Amurar (kijjit) ittbanu s 'P' 
        - Wagguren ganin s '#' 
        - Takat ganin s 'X' 
        - Iɣeln ur ganin ganin s 'O'
        - Takat ɣef iɣeln ganin s '√'
        Tzemreḍ ad tseqqed [w] i uflla, [a] i tamaẓẓayt, [s] i wadda, d [d] i tamaɣnit.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aɣbalu n uṭṭun ur igi ara aṭas n tɛebbuṛt. Sken [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Aseqqad ittwaser darɣa ur igi awd tɣarast iɣeln.
invalid_move.wall_collision: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵜⴰⵡⴹⴷ ⵖⵔ ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵉⵔ!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Aseqqad ur imɣin - ur tzemreḍ ad tmunt ɣer wakud-nni.

outcome.turn_limit: Tɣzi n wakud tɛṣṣaṣ. Ur tzemreḍ a ten-tekkes tamukrist.
